ValidationRule.description: Error Message to be thrown when the Review Outcome field is set to Pass and the respective document identifers for supporting documents are missing.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), (RecordType.DeveloperName = "Profile_Update"), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Legal Name QA"), ISPICKVAL(Fraud_Review_Outcome__c, "Pass"), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(DocumentType__c, "DOCUMENT_TYPE_AUSTRALIAN_DRIVERS_LICENCE"), OR(ISBLANK(LicenceCardNumber__c), ISBLANK(LicenceNumber__c)) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(DocumentType__c, "DOCUMENT_TYPE_AUSTRALIAN_PASSPORT"), ISBLANK(PassportNumber__c) ), AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( DocumentType__c, "DOCUMENT_TYPE_AUSTRALIAN_BIRTH_CERTIFICATE" ), ISPICKVAL( DocumentType__c, "DOCUMENT_TYPE_AUSTRALIAN_CHANGE_OF_NAME_CERTIFICATE" ), ISPICKVAL( DocumentType__c, "DOCUMENT_TYPE_AUSTRALIAN_MARRIAGE_CERTIFICATE" ) ), ISBLANK(CertificateIdentifier__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Supporting Document identifiers are missing, please check the supporting document section and fill them.
